stays.note: Boarding school in Leeuwarden; there in Jan 1873 and on 24 Feb 1874
evidence: inferred: bounds not given; she was in Leeuwarden Jan 1873 and Feb 1874 and planned (Mar 1874) to study French before going to England (let020 n.3), so she may have left Leeuwarden earlier than the end bound used here

stays.note: At her parents' home before leaving for London with Vincent
evidence: inferred: start bound unknown; family together at Helvoirt 4-5 July

stays.note: Arrived with Vincent 15 July; lodged with the Parkers, Ivy Cottage, 395 Kennington Road
Teaching at Miss Applegarth's school, Welwyn, from end Aug 1874; lived with Mrs Catherine Stothard (Ivy Cottage)
evidence: inferred: end bound - she was still writing from Welwyn on 4 Oct 1876 and was at home in Etten by 31 Dec 1876 (let100)

stays.note: At her parents' home, looking for a position; left for Hengelo 6 Apr 1877
Companion/governess with the Van Houten family
evidence: inferred: end bound unknown; in Hengelo Feb 1878, in Etten by June-July 1878 (let145 n.20)

stays.note: Remained in Etten until her marriage to Joan van Houten on 22 Aug 1878
Married Joan van Houten (lime-burners Van Houten & Ledeboer, Leiderdorp); by 1889 the family lived in Leiden
evidence: inferred: no note places the couple between the wedding (Aug 1878) and 1884; Leiderdorp assumed from Joan's firm and the 1885 notes (let540 n.2 says 'Leiden')

stays.note: Arrived ill at her parents' home on 11 July 1873; length of stay unknown
Summer at home with her parents; left on 25 Aug to return to Welwyn
evidence: inferred: start bound unknown; she was at home on 2 Aug
